notes: Firefinch Ltd (ASX: FFX): listed 6 Dec 2006; suspended 29 Jun 2022; removed from Official List 28 Jun 2024. mines.mine_notes: 80%-owned gold mine in Mali (West Africa), acquired November 2020 from Barrick/AngloGold Ashanti. Multi-million-ounce historic producer. Operations: pit dewatering, satellite pits (Viper) mining, Morila Super Pit pre-stripping underway in early 2022. Production ramp-up failed mid-2022: June 2022 quarter ~13,300 oz (guidance 17-20k), March 2022 quarter 11,115 oz, calendar 2022 guidance withdrawn. Held through Societe des Mines de Morila SA (Morila SA). Feb 2023: court opened 'preventive procedure' re Morila SA. Firefinch wrote down Morila shareholding to nil and considers itself not liable for Morila SA debts (not a party to agreements with Morila SA vendors/suppliers). Aug 2023: Mali Minister of Mines letter - Government will not approve any deed of sale of Firefinch's Morila interest unless Morila Gold Mine issues resolved. May 2024: settlement with Government of Mali & agreement with Leo/Ganfeng; arbitration notice from Entreprise Generale Traore et Freres (May 2024). Mine not producing under Firefinch since 2022. [production_notes: No production since 2022.
